sources.note: Town of Guilford, Annual Town Meeting minutes, February 28, 2026, Article 4 (as amended) elects exactly four officers -- a Cemetery Commissioner (5-year), two Library Trustees (4-year and 3-year), and a Trustee of Public Funds (3-year) -- and names four nominees, elected by one voice vote ('All in Favor'). Three nominees are assigned in the minutes to the cemetery and library seats; the fourth, Elly Majonen, takes the only unassigned office, Trustee of Public Funds. 'Elly' is the diminutive of Ellen Majonen, the town's treasurer and delinquent tax collector -- her existing person record is reused. Minted elected with this elimination chain disclosed; see the sweep report on issue #163, which also flags that two library trustees from this same vote were recorded differently in an earlier batch.
